visualCharacteristics.purpose: embeds the third-party ReCollect What Goes Where recycling lookup / collection calendar widget (vendor script)

contentPattern.structure: optional key/value rows: area | CityNorthVancouver, name | wizard or calendar, page | tabbed_widget, service | waste, script | vendor script URL

reuseGuidance: One per page, on the garbage and recycling pages. The widget title bar, tabs, search and item links all come from the vendor script; do not rebuild them.
